note: Sound effects extracted from the user's two reference videos (voice removed with UVR-MDX-NET-Inst_HQ_3). Files are peak-normalised to -1 dBFS; multiply by suggested_volume to match the original level relative to a ~-11 LUFS voice mix.

items.description: Low punchy "thump" with short tail — the signature sound used every time a proof card (tweet / screenshot / UI panel) pops in. Reused 6× across both videos.
items.use_when: A card, screenshot or overlay pops onto the screen (sync the hit to the first frame of the card).

items.description: Dark low rumble/sting under the opening hook of the horror video (continues ~2 s into the story).
items.use_when: Opening hook of a scary / tense video.

items.description: Closing sting when the hook graphic returns before the end card (includes a card pop at the end-card moment).
items.use_when: Hook callback + end card of a scary / tense video.

items.description: Bright tonal alert (two quick hits) on the red circle/arrow hook frame.
items.use_when: Opening hook of an energetic / news video — on the frame the red circle appears.

items.description: Short swoosh on the quick dissolve from the hook into the story.
items.use_when: Cut/dissolve out of the hook into the main story, or any quick transition.

items.description: Bigger whoosh/impact that goes with the orange fire-streak swipe transition.
items.use_when: Full-screen swipe transition between two sections / topic change.
